payload.title: File:Baiyinosaurus Skeletal.svg
payload.description_html:
Skeletal diagram of Baiyinosaurus baojiensis showing known fossil material of the holotype specimen (IVPG-D021). All skull bones are shown on the left side (including a mirrored right jugal and squamosal) for clarity. Scale bar=1 m.

Key

 =Holotype (IVPG-D021)
 =Unknown

References

  • "A new stegosaur (Dinosauria: Ornithischia) from the Middle Jurassic of Gansu Province, China"
  • Gigantspinosaurus skeletal by Genya Masukawa
  • "Redescription of Gigantspinosaurus sichuanensis (Dinosauria, Stegosauria) from the Late Jurassic of Sichuan, Southwestern China"
  • "The skull of the basal stegosaur Huayangosaurus taibaii and a cladistic diagnosis of Stegosauria"
  • "The Postcranial Skeleton of an Exceptionally Complete Individual of the Plated Dinosaur Stegosaurus stenops (Dinosauria: Thyreophora) from the Upper Jurassic Morrison Formation of Wyoming, U.S.A."
  • Paul, Gregory S. (2024) The Princeton Field Guide to Dinosaurs (3rd ed.), Princeton, N.J.: Princeton University Press ISBN: 9978-0-691-23157-0.
